high_level_description: The image is a map of India, highlighting the per capita income growth of 12 out of 23 states for the period 2022-23 compared to 2019-20. The map uses different shades of color to represent the percentage growth in real per capita income: Dark red: <7% Orange: 7-10% Light blue: 10-13% Dark blue: ≥13% Tamil Nadu has the highest growth rate at 15.5%, indicated
